q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue was $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, as announced on May 20, 2026, when the company reported its Q1 FY2027 financial results [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027). This guidance is significantly above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion, according to LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). NVIDIA explicitly stated that its Q2 FY2027 outlook does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA also expects GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins of 74.9% and 75.0%, respectively (plus or minus 50 basis points), and GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses of approximately $8.5 billion and $8.3 billion, respectively [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/).
